title: Colonic epithelial cell isolation for Single Cell RNA-sequencing
author: David Fawkner-Corbett
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ztrf6m6

steps.title: Transport biopsies on ice
steps.instruction: Place biopsies in 10 ml transport medium and keep on ice.

steps.title: Wash biopsies three times
steps.instruction: Wash biopsies with 10 ml cold wash medium (4 °C), shake, discard, and repeat for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Transfer to warm chelation medium
steps.instruction: Move biopsies to 5 ml chelation medium pre‑warmed in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Incubate 20 min with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 20 min, shaking the tube after 10 min and again at 20 min.

steps.title: Refresh chelation medium
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and transfer biopsies to fresh 5 ml warm chelation medium.

steps.title: Incubate 10 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the biopsies in the fresh chelation medium at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Vortex biopsies
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube twice for 5 s each (or perform 5–10 hard shakes).

steps.title: Settle and replace supernatant
steps.instruction: Allow biopsies to settle, remove supernatant with an FCS‑coated Pasteur pipette, keep the supernatant, add 5 ml warm chelation medium, and return to the 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Spin down crypt‑containing supernatant
steps.instruction: If the supernatant contains crypts, centrifuge at 300 g for 4 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend crypt pellet on ice
steps.instruction: Resuspend the crypt pellet in 2 ml cold transport medium and place the suspension in a 15 ml Falcon tube on ice.

steps.title: Repeat chelation and pool crypts
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 5–9 (refresh chelation medium, 10 min incubation, vortex, settle, spin) up to three or four times, pooling all crypt‑containing fractions.

steps.title: Spin pooled crypt suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled crypt suspension at 300 g for 4 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in TrypLE Express with DNAse
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 3 ml warm TrypLE Express containing DNAse at 50 µg ml⁻¹, kept at 37 °C.

steps.title: Digest cells 45 min with agitation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 45 min with agitation or rotation (e.g., MACSmix).

steps.title: Quench digestion with FCS medium
steps.instruction: Add 3 ml transport medium supplemented with 5 % FCS to stop the enzymatic reaction.

steps.title: Filter and wash cell suspension
steps.instruction: Remove the filter, then wash the suspension with 15 ml transport medium containing 5 % FCS.

steps.title: Wash pellet with wash medium
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant and wash the pellet with 10 ml wash medium.

steps.title: Spin and reduce volume
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min, then carefully remove supernatant leaving approximately 1 ml, and gently resuspend the pellet in the remaining liquid.

steps.title: Strain through 30 µm filter
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 30 µm cell strainer pre‑coated with FCS and wash the strainer with 5 ml PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Spin and adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 g for 4 min, aspirate supernatant until less than 1 ml remains, resuspend cells in the remaining PBS + 0.04 % BSA, transfer to an Eppendorf tube, and add PBS + 0.04 % BSA to bring the total volume to 1 ml.

steps.title: Count cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Take 10 µl of the suspension and count cells using Trypan blue with an Invitrogen Countess or a haemocytometer; perform three technical replicates per sample and calculate average count and viability, aiming for high viability.

steps.title: Adjust concentration to 1000 cells/µl
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min, then resuspend the pellet using the live cell count to achieve a final concentration of 1 000 cells µl⁻¹ (1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Filter through 70 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer pre‑coated with FCS into a 50 ml Falcon tube and wash the strainer with 5 ml transport medium containing 5 % FCS.

steps.title: Final spin of filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 300 g for 4 min.
